candidates.summary: when the realm cap is reached the plan drops changed realms, but the comment still links every one of them and tells the reader the changed realms are always kept
candidates.failure_scenario: A PR that touches more than --max-realms (default 25) realm directories, an examples-wide sweep such as a gnomod.toml migration across the 145 packages under examples/gno.land. BuildPlan caps plan.Realms (plan.go:256-259) and sets Dropped, but plan.ChangedRealms keeps every changed realm, and Comment's "Changed realms (N)" loop links all of them plus their _t/source/ and _t/help/ tabs. gnodev is only ever given plan.Dirs, built from the capped Realms, so the dropped realms have no page in the static output and every link to them 404s. The closing note then states the opposite: "N more affected realm(s) were **not** rendered (cap reached) - the changed realms are always kept."
candidates.verify_by: cp tests/b10-lines-cap-drops-changed-realms_test.go misc/gnopreview/b10_cap_test.go && cd misc/gnopreview && go test -run TestB10CapDropsChangedRealms -v ./...
